feature_name: Dynamic Route Fallback Fix for Frontend Path
description: Update the static file server configuration to correctly locate the 404.html fallback file when a custom frontend_path is configured. Currently, dynamic routes in production break because the server looks for 404.html at the wrong location when static files are built into a subdirectory.
functional_requirements: Modify the static file serving command to use the configured frontend_path when looking for the 404.html fallback file
Ensure dynamic routes in production correctly fall back to 404.html when accessed directly
Maintain backward compatibility for deployments without a custom frontend_path
